title: CreateAnalyticsInstanceDetails
description: Input payload to create an Anaytics instance.

adminUser.description: user name of the authorized user.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only the String type is supported.

Key-value pair representing a defined tag key and value, scoped to a namespace.

Example: `{"CostCenter": "42"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a
namespace. For more information, see [Resource Tags](/Content/General/Concepts/resourcetags.htm).

Example: `{"Operations": {"CostCenter": "42"}}`

domainId.description: domain id for which the user is authorized.

featureBundle.description: The feature set of an Analytics instance.

freeformTags.description:
Free-form tags for this resource. Each tag is a simple key-value pair with no
predefined name, type, or namespace. For more information, see [Resource Tags](/Content/General/Concepts/resourcetags.htm).

Example: `{"Department": "Finance"}`

idcsAccessToken.description: IDCS access token identifying a stripe and service administrator user.

kmsKeyId.description: OCID of the OCI Vault Key encrypting the customer data stored in this Analytics instance. A null value indicates Oracle managed default encryption.

licenseType.description: The license used for the service.

name.description: The name of the Analytics instance. This name must be unique in the tenancy and cannot be changed.

Capacity.description: Service instance capacity metadata (e.g.: OLPU count, number of users, ...etc...).

capacityType.description:
The capacity model to use.
Accepted values are:
OLPU_COUNT, USER_COUNT

capacityValue.description:
The capacity value selected, either the number of OCPUs (OLPU_COUNT) or the number of users (USER_COUNT).
This parameter affects the number of OCPUs, amount of memory, and other resources allocated to the instance.

NetworkEndpointDetails.description: Base representation of a network endpoint.
